observations: Three photos show two large car engines side by side in a cluttered workshop or garage.
The engine on the left has a silver valve cover with 'PORSCHE' visible on the side.
The engine on the right has a black valve cover with 'PORSCHE' and 'TURBO' visible.
Both engines have red handwritten markings on the intake manifold: 'F13' and 'F13'.
The engines appear to be used, with visible grime, oil residue, and some wear.
The environment is dimly lit, with concrete walls and wooden shelves in the background.
No visible damage to the engines themselves, but no clear view of the cylinder head, block, or other components.
The watermark 'EZE PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS' is present on all photos.

claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: The seller's text states this, but no other photos or details confirm the full range of spare parts offered. The current photos show only two engines.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Engine may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., internal wear, seized components, or missing parts)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the cylinder head, block, and internal components, or a video showing the engine running.

risks.risk: Engine may not be from the claimed model (F13) or may be from a different vehicle
risks.proof: Clear photo of the engine's VIN tag or casting number, or a photo showing the engine's serial number and model code.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown model, which may be lower value

risks.risk: Engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle
risks.proof: Photo of the engine's serial number and any damage markings, or a video showing the engine's condition from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged, which reduces value

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine's VIN tag or casting number.
Close-up photos of the cylinder head, block, and internal components.
Video showing the engine running or being tested.
Photo of any damage or wear on the engine block or components.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
